items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: But I played with Duke. Duke came up here to do the track... he started playing 'Tuxedo Junction'. And he got up there, he stopped. I said, 'Mercer, give me that trumpet.' ... Just a little get together in a place like that, you know.

ctx.x: What was your first contact that you can remember with the name bands in terms of listening, not performing?

Oh, listening. Well, that was in Birmingham. At the time, well, it was no contact. Just listening. That was with Duke Ellington.
But, my contact when I got to 'Bama State, then I had a chance to meet them.
All right. Another way then. When did you first hear live performances by any of the big bands that you were mentioning?
